item.title: Eihwar: Nordic Ritual Nights USA Tour 2026
item.description:
Friday, September 4, 2026 at 7 PM

Location: White Oak Music Hall - Downstairs, 2915 N Main St, Houston, TX

Fans of Viking music, get ready for the Nordic Rituals of EIHWAR! Hailing from Europe, these feral warriors set Viking dance floors ablaze with their shamanic drums, magical chants, and powerful electro beats. Backed by Season of Mist, home to Heilung and Danheim, Eihwar have burst onto the folk scene with millions of YouTube views and appearances at festivals like Hellfest, Wacken Open Air, and Midgardsblot, as well as an invitation to open select shows for the Mongolian folk metal band The HU. Seize this exceptional opportunity to see them live in the United States for the first time.
